prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For most small businesses, **Otterly.AI** is the best all-around starting point if you want a paid service to check whether ChatGPT and similar AI engines recommend your business.[2][14] It is repeatedly positioned as a strong small-team option because it tracks mentions, citations, sentiment, and share of voice without the complexity or cost of enterprise tools.[2][8][14]

If you want the **best free baseline**, use a free AI visibility checker first, such as **AIScope** or **Arobis AI Visibility Checker**, to see whether your business is named in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity before paying for monitoring.[2][5] These tools are described as good starting points for understanding your current AI visibility.[2][5]

A practical shortlist for a small business is:

- **Otterly.AI** — best value paid option for basic monitoring and citations.[2][8][14]
- **HubSpot AEO** — best if you already use HubSpot and want AI visibility tied to your CRM and marketing workflow.[4][12][17]
- **Semrush AI Visibility** — best if you already pay for Semrush and want AI visibility alongside SEO reporting.[2][13]
- **Radarkit / AI Visibility Check** — best if your main need is **local** AI recommendations for a Google Business Profile or local business query.[3][9]
- **Arobis AI Visibility Checker / AIScope** — best free first check.[2][5]

If you want one recommendation without more context: **start with Otterly.AI**, and if you need a no-cost check first, use **AIScope or Arobis** to establish a baseline.[2][5][14]
